author: Chris Pinson
title: Billiards of Springfield hosts Lady Bears Watch Party - NewsBreak
text:
By Chris Pinson ,
1 hours ago
SPRINGFIELD–For the droves of Lady Bears supporters who couldn’t make it to Austin, TX to watch Missouri State face Stephen F. Austin in the “play in” game of the Women’s NCAA Tournament, Billiards of Springfield hosted a “watch party” for fans to gather and cheer on the maroon and white.
Current and former Missouri State students, almuni, and faculty packed into Corner Pocket’s intimate room to witness Beth Cunningham’s team defeat the LadyJacks, Wednesday night, and punch their ticket to face No. 1-seeded Texas, on Friday.
Collen Fuller currently attends MSU and was appreciative of the sports bar’s efforts to host.
“Many of us college students are broke,” said Fuller. “So obviously I couldn’t go, we all couldn’t go, most of us couldn’t go. But I think it’s really cool that Billiards wanted to bring this community together and help support the Lady Bears as much as possible.”
Caroline Helton, a former teacher with the university believed in the team, despite them not being a favorite to go deep in the 64-team tournament.
“They have a chance,” said Helton. “It’s kinda slim, but they have a chance and I think it’s because they stick together, they don’t give up, and they play with a lot of guts.”
Overall, those in attendance enjoyed watching the game, winning prizes, and, of course, dining on delicious food and drink.
Missouri’s 85-75 victory marks the team’s first win in the NCAA Tournament, since the team last appeared at the Big Dance back in 2022.
